children: NTPC Limited (NSE:NTPC) is reshaping fuel and capacity plans—boosting commercial coal sourcing to 10–15mt/yr from FY28 while targeting ~50mt captive and ~300mt FY27 demand, investing ~Rs14,000cr in a Talaipalli coal‑to‑SNG plant, cutting a Rs413cr battery contract, and retaining Jefferies’ top‑pick status despite stock drawdowns.
NTPC Plans Ten-Mt From Commercial Miners
: NTPC plans ~10mt coal from commercial miners in H2 FY27, aims 10–15mt/yr from commercial mines from FY28, targets ~50mt from captive mines, and forecasts ~300mt total coal need for FY27.
: NTPC reports coal stock at 20.6M tonnes versus 55M at fiscal start and 44M in July. September power demand rose 11.35% to 162B units; peak topped 269GW.
: NTPC to invest ~Rs14,000 crore in Talaipalli coal‑to‑SNG plant targeting 0.5mtpa. DPR done, land ready, seeks ~Rs2,000cr VGF, foreign tech partners, bank debt; construction after clearances.
Jefferies Keeps NTPC As Top Pick
: Jefferies India kept NTPC as a top power pick, noting NTPC’s loan mix and regulated returns cut rate-sensitivity — EPS impact ~2–4% per 100bp rise for FY28–FY30 despite RBI hike.
: NTPC terminated a Rs 413 crore contract with GR Infraprojects for a 400 MWh battery storage at Mouda, encashed ~Rs 91 crore performance security and began contract termination procedures.
